meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会给 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮件通道:复制并注册邮件适配器,安装依赖,再构建和测试;然后请你填写 Resend 密钥、发件地址等,写入 .env,把你的邮箱设为所有者,并向它发送一封问候邮件。
howto.when: 当用户提出要给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件、或要求配置邮箱通道时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件通道。
say.note: 会复制适配器并完成注册、构建和测试。

say.text: 用 Resend 把邮箱接到 NanoClaw,先发一封测试邮件给我。
say.note: 会提示你填 API 密钥和邮箱,然后发问候邮件。

say.text: 帮我配置 Resend 邮件,把我设为所有者并回复到该邮箱。
say.note: 会把你设为所有者并绑定 agent 来回复邮件。

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Resend email channel to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs the dependency, builds and tests, then prompts for Resend credentials to write into `.env`, sets the user as owner, and sends a hello email.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a Resend email channel to NanoClaw (e.g., "connect email").

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Starts the adapter copy, registration, build, and tests.

say_en.text: Connect email to NanoClaw via Resend and send me a test email.
say_en.note: Prompts for your API key and email, then sends a hello.

say_en.text: Set up Resend email, make me the owner, and have an agent reply to it.
say_en.note: Wires your address as owner and connects an agent to answer it.
